title: Open table tennis tournament in memory of Mihail N. Polcanov
body_html:
In memoriam, for the future

“Those who do not honour their past will not understand the present, nor know their future or themselves” – Voltaire

In a few days, the TOP CUP Academy Arena in Chișinău will host, under the auspices of ATTP, the start of the open table tennis tournament in memory of Mihail N. Polcanov (1952-2015).

For the third year running, this meaningful tournament is organised by the late coach’s daughter, Sofia — the famous Master of Sport, European champion and legend of Moldovan women’s table tennis.

More than 200 players of all ages and from every region of the country are expected to take part in this extraordinary event.

As always, in the same place, table tennis fans from all over the country will gather to support the competition in memory of the master and honoured table tennis coach Mihail Polcanov, a true example of dedication and passion for the sport.
